Former handle: http://hdl.handle.net/11272/10050

Microdata file replaced 2024-10-30 with original SPSS .sav file. Data content is unchanged. Documentation updated with notes and codebook/frequences replaced with more optimized versions. File names changed for clarity.

The variables contained in the data sets are primarily concerned with perinatal outcomes and maternal health.The types of fields are wide-ranging but are primarily concerned with infant birth, maternal health, and socioeconomic status.
